common.name: Name
common.stale_body: Someone else saved changes to this record. Reload to see them; your unsaved edits will be discarded.

auth.title: Hotel Management System
auth.subtitle: Sign in with your staff account
auth.totp_prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
auth.no_hotel_body: Your account is not assigned to any hotel yet. Ask an administrator to grant you a role.

connection.online_hint: Connected to the hotel server; changes from other devices appear instantly.
connection.offline_hint: The hotel server cannot be reached. Retrying automatically.
connection.banner_body: Data on screen may be out of date. Saving is disabled until the connection returns; it will reconnect automatically.

settings.description: Everything about your property, configurable without developer help.

profile.name: Hotel name
profile.operations_hint: Time zone and currency are used for every date, report and price in this hotel.

structure.hint: Describe how the property is organised. Rooms are placed in a building and on a floor.
structure.level_hint: 0 = ground floor, negative numbers for basements
structure.empty_hint: Even a single-building hotel benefits from defining its floors.

room_types.hint: Room categories are what you sell: occupancy, beds, base price and amenities. Create as many as you need.
room_types.empty_hint: Start from a template or create your own category.

amenities.hint: Amenities describe rooms and categories. The defaults are translated; add your own as needed.

taxes.hint: Taxes applied to accommodation and services, in the order shown.
taxes.empty_hint: Add VAT, accommodation tax or city tax as required in your country.

kinds.fixed_per_person_night: Fixed amount per person per night

currencies.hint: Foreign currencies accepted for payments. Amounts are always billed in {{base}}; a payment in another currency is converted at the rate below, and the rate used is kept on the payment.
currencies.empty_hint: Add a currency (for example KHR) to accept payments in it.
currencies.rate_hint: Update it whenever your rate changes. Past payments keep the rate they used.
currencies.delete_body: Payments already received in this currency are not affected.

rooms.delete_hint: Only rooms without any history can be deleted. Deactivate the room instead to take it out of sale.
rooms.empty_hint: Add rooms one by one or create a numbered series.
rooms.no_categories_hint: Rooms belong to a category. Go to Configuration › Room categories.
rooms.name: Display name
rooms.inherits: Leave empty to use the category value ({{value}})
rooms.override_beds: This room has a different bed configuration than its category
rooms.extra_amenities_hint: In addition to the category amenities
rooms.bulk_hint: Create many rooms at once with consecutive numbers. You can edit each room afterwards.
rooms.bulk_invalid: Enter a range of 1 to 500 rooms.

services.description: Facilities guests can use and services you can sell, in every language.
services.services_hint: Extras that can be added to a stay (breakfast, transfers, laundry…), priced independently of room categories.
services.no_facilities_hint: Describe your pool, restaurant, spa, parking and more.
services.facility_hint: Optional link to the facility providing this service

users.description: Staff accounts, roles, connected devices and the audit trail.
users.cannot_change_own_roles: You cannot change your own roles.
users.password_policy: At least 10 characters; avoid common passwords.
users.account_active: Account active (inactive accounts are signed out everywhere)
users.reset_password_hint: The user will be signed out on all devices and must use the new password.
users.password_reset_done: Password reset; all sessions were signed out

roles.hint: A role is a set of permissions. System roles cannot be edited; duplicate one to customise it.
roles.not_grantable: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot grant it

codes.config_rooms_manage: Manage buildings, room categories and rooms
codes.folio_adjust: Adjust folios (void charges, discounts, waive fees, leave balances open)
codes.restaurant_settle: Take payment and charge checks to rooms
codes.restaurant_void: Void items and payments, give discounts
codes.restaurant_manage: Set up outlets, menus and tables; see sales
codes.vehicles_rent: Rent vehicles: book, hand over, take back, take payment
codes.vehicles_manage: Manage the fleet and rates; void payments, discounts, waive late fees

sessions.revoke_body: The session ends immediately and the device returns to the sign-in screen.

audit.immutable: The audit log cannot be edited or deleted.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, language, password and signed-in devices.
account.language_hint: Each staff member can use their own language.
account.password_hint: Changing your password signs you out on all other devices.
account.2fa_hint: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app.
account.2fa_step1: 1. Add this key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 2FAS…):
account.2fa_step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app:
account.sessions_hint: Sign out devices you no longer use.

validation.literal_error: Choose one of the allowed values
validation.url_scheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://

errors.SENSITIVE_FIELDS_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to edit identity documents

errors.RATE_PLAN_HAS_CHILDREN: Other rate plans are based on this one. Change them first.
errors.RATE_PLAN_IN_USE: This rate plan is used by reservations and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.RATE_PLAN_CYCLE: A rate plan cannot be based on itself (directly or indirectly)
errors.DERIVATION_REQUIRED: Choose how this plan differs from the plan it is based on
errors.DEFAULT_PLAN_REQUIRED: The hotel needs a default rate plan: choose another default first

errors.NO_DEFAULT_RATE_PLAN: No default rate plan is configured

errors.SEASON_DATES_REQUIRED: A season needs a start and an end date
errors.WEEKDAYS_REQUIRED: Choose at least one day of the week
errors.DISCOUNT_TOO_LARGE: A reduction must be smaller than 100 %
errors.MAX_STAY_BELOW_MIN: The maximum stay cannot be shorter than the minimum stay
errors.RATE_PLAN_INACTIVE: This rate is not available for sale
errors.RATE_PLAN_NOT_FOR_ROOM_TYPE: This rate is not offered for this room category
errors.RATE_PLAN_NOT_VALID_FOR_DATES: This rate is not valid for these dates
errors.RATE_PLAN_BOOKING_WINDOW: This rate cannot be booked this close to (or this far from) arrival
errors.MIN_STAY_NOT_MET: Minimum stay for this arrival: {{min_stay}} nights
errors.MAX_STAY_EXCEEDED: Maximum stay for this arrival: {{max_stay}} nights
errors.ROOM_NOT_ASSIGNED: Assign a room before checking in.
errors.ROOM_STILL_OCCUPIED: Room {{room}} is still occupied by reservation {{reservation}}. Check that guest out first.
errors.CHECK_IN_TOO_EARLY: Check-in is possible from the arrival date ({{arrival}}).
errors.NOTHING_TO_CHECK_OUT: No room of this reservation is in house.
errors.NOT_IN_HOUSE: This guest is not in house.
errors.UNDO_CHECK_IN_EXPIRED: A check-in can only be undone on the day it was made.
errors.EARLY_DEPARTURE: The guest is leaving before the planned departure ({{departure}}).
errors.BALANCE_DUE: A balance of {{balance}} {{currency}} is still due.
errors.CREDIT_BALANCE: The guest has a credit of {{balance}} {{currency}}.
errors.CURRENCY_NOT_ACCEPTED: {{currency}} is not accepted. Add it under Configuration → Currencies.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_CHANGED: The {{currency}} rate has just changed to {{rate}}. Check the amount and confirm again.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_PAID: A refund cannot exceed what was paid ({{max}}).
errors.INVOICE_ALREADY_ISSUED: An invoice is already issued for this reservation. Void it first to issue a new one.
errors.NOTHING_TO_INVOICE: Nothing to invoice: the total is zero.
errors.BASE_CURRENCY: This is already the hotel's currency.
errors.SERVICE_INACTIVE: This service is not available any more.
errors.SERVICE_IN_USE: This service has been charged to guests and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.FINANCIAL_RECORD_IMMUTABLE: Financial records cannot be changed or deleted; void them instead.
errors.card_number_not_allowed: Card numbers must never be entered here. Use the last 4 digits field only.
errors.TASK_EXISTS: This room already has a task of this type for that day.
errors.TASK_NOT_PENDING: Only a task that has not started can be deleted.
errors.TASK_ASSIGNED_TO_SOMEONE_ELSE: This task is assigned to someone else.
errors.INVALID_TASK_TRANSITION: This task has already moved on (someone else may have updated it).
errors.NOT_HOUSEKEEPING_STAFF: This person is not housekeeping staff in this hotel.
errors.NOT_MAINTENANCE_STAFF: This person is not a maintenance technician in this hotel.
errors.MAINTENANCE_CLOSED: This request is closed. Reopen it first.
errors.NO_ROOM_TO_BLOCK: This request is not about a room.
errors.ROOM_NOT_BLOCKED: The room is not out of service.
errors.TABLE_OCCUPIED: This table already has an open check.
errors.OUTLET_CODE_EXISTS: An outlet with this code already exists.
errors.TABLE_LABEL_EXISTS: A table with this name already exists here.
errors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category still has items. Move or delete them first.
errors.OUTLET_IN_USE: This outlet has checks and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.TABLE_IN_USE: This table has checks and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.MENU_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: Item not found on this menu.
errors.CATEGORY_OTHER_OUTLET: This category belongs to another outlet.
errors.GUEST_NOT_IN_HOUSE: This guest is not staying at the hotel at the moment.

errors.NOTHING_TO_SEND: There is nothing new to send.
errors.INVALID_LINE_TRANSITION: This item has already moved on.
errors.LINE_NOT_SENT: This item was not sent yet: just remove it.
errors.DISCOUNT_BELOW_PAID: With this discount the check would be less than what was already paid.
errors.ORDER_HAS_PAYMENTS: This check has payments. Void them first.
errors.UNSENT_ITEMS: Send the new items to the kitchen first.
errors.ROOM_CHARGE_FULL_ONLY: Only a check with no payment yet can be charged to a room.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_BALANCE: This is more than the {{balance}} due.
errors.BREAKFAST_NOT_INCLUDED: Breakfast is not included for this guest today.
errors.TOO_MANY_COVERS: At most {{max}} breakfasts for this room.
errors.BREAKFAST_MARK_NOT_FOUND: No breakfast recorded for this room today.
errors.VOID_FROM_OUTLET: This is a restaurant or bar check: void it from the check, not from the folio.

errors.VEHICLE_IN_USE: This vehicle has rentals and cannot be deleted. Retire it instead.
errors.VEHICLE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Vehicle {{vehicle}} cannot be rented at the moment ({{status}}).
errors.INSURANCE_EXPIRED: The insurance of {{vehicle}} ends on {{date}}: renew it before renting.
errors.REGISTRATION_EXPIRED: The registration of {{vehicle}} ends on {{date}}: renew it before renting.

errors.PICKUP_TOO_EARLY: Too early to hand over this vehicle.
errors.VEHICLE_NOT_RETURNED: {{vehicle}} has not been returned yet by rental {{rental}}.
errors.LICENCE_REQUIRED: A driving licence is required for this vehicle.
errors.LICENCE_EXPIRED: The driving licence expires before the end of the rental.
errors.ODOMETER_BELOW_RECORDED: The odometer cannot be below {{odometer}} km.
errors.INVALID_RETURN_TIME: This return time is not possible.
errors.NO_DEPOSIT_HELD: No deposit is held for this rental.
errors.NO_SHOW_BEFORE_START: A no-show can only be recorded after the start time.
errors.RENTAL_HAS_PAYMENTS: This rental has payments. Void them first.
errors.ROOM_CHARGE_AFTER_RETURN: A rental can be charged to the room once the vehicle is returned (the final amount is then known).

reservations.description: Every booking, whatever its source. Click a reservation to manage it.
reservations.search: Code, guest name, email or OTA reference
reservations.empty_hint: Create a reservation here or click an empty cell in the calendar.
reservations.modified_hint: Dates, room or details were changed after booking (see History)
reservations.overbooked_hint: Accepted while the category had no free room: assign a room or move the booking
reservations.cancelled_done: Reservation cancelled; the room is available again
reservations.no_show_done: Marked as no-show; the room is available again
reservations.no_show_body: The guest did not arrive. The room will be released for the remaining nights.
reservations.cancel_body: The rooms are released immediately. This cannot be undone.
reservations.dates_price_hint: Nights already booked keep their price; new nights are priced at today's rates.

form.summary_hint: Choose dates and a room category to see the price.
form.overbook_body: This category is fully booked on {{night}}. You can still accept the booking as an overbooking; it will be flagged until a room is found.
form.restricted_body: These dates do not meet the rate's restrictions. Choose other dates or another rate, or ask a manager.
form.override_restrictions: Override the restrictions for this booking

reservations.change_rate_body: Switch to “{{plan}}”. Every night is repriced at today's rates: {{old}} → {{new}}.

calendar.hint_edit: Click an empty day to book · drag a booking to change room or dates (long-press on tablets)
calendar.hint_view: Click a booking to see its details
calendar.move_other_category: Room {{room}} is a {{category}}; the guest booked {{booked}}. The booked price is kept.
calendar.block_hint: The room cannot be sold for these dates. Existing bookings must be moved first.

guests.description: Guest profiles, stay history and preferences.
guests.tags_hint: Press Enter after each tag (e.g. honeymoon, allergy)
guests.marketing_consent: Agrees to receive offers by email
guests.identity_hidden: Identity details are only visible to authorised staff.
guests.identity_on_file: An identity document is on file (visible to authorised staff only).

pricing.description: Rate plans, seasons, discounts and the daily rate calendar. One pricing engine is used everywhere.

grid.no_categories: This rate plan applies to no active room category.
grid.derived_hint: Prices follow “{{parent}}” automatically. Set a price here only to override it.
grid.inherited: Restrictions inherited from the parent plan
grid.legend_computed: calculated from base price and rules
grid.legend_restrictions: ≥ minimum stay · ≤ maximum stay · CTA/CTD closed to arrival/departure

source.base: Base price with seasons and rules

bulk.weekdays_hint: Leave all unselected to apply to every day.
bulk.percent_hint: Use a negative value to lower prices (e.g. −10)
bulk.clear_hint: Removes manual prices: the dates go back to the base price, seasons and rules.
bulk.existing_bookings_hint: Existing reservations keep their price; changes apply to new bookings.

plans.hint: A rate plan is what you sell: meal plan, cancellation terms and price. Derived plans follow another plan automatically (e.g. non-refundable = best rate −10 %).
plans.is_default: Default rate plan (used when none is chosen)
plans.based_on_hint: Leave empty for a plan with its own rates

rules.hint: Seasons, weekends and demand adjust the calculated price. Long-stay, last-minute and early-bird discounts apply on top of any price. Rules apply in priority order.
rules.empty_hint: Add a high season, a weekend price or a long-stay discount.
rules.weekdays_hint: The night of the selected days (Friday = Friday night). Leave empty for every day.

kind_hints.season: Adjusts prices for nights within a period: high or low season, festivals, events.
kind_hints.weekday: Adjusts prices on chosen days of the week, e.g. Friday and Saturday nights.
kind_hints.occupancy: Raises (or lowers) prices when the category is filling up.
kind_hints.long_stay: Discount for stays of at least a number of nights.
kind_hints.last_minute: Discount for bookings made shortly before arrival.
kind_hints.early_bird: Discount for bookings made well in advance.

policies.hint: Cancellation terms attached to rate plans and shown on reservations.
policies.fees_later: Cancellation fees will be charged automatically once payments and folios are available (front desk module).

frontdesk.description: Today's arrivals, guests in house and departures, with check-in, check-out and the status of every room.
frontdesk.planning_view: Planning view for {{date}}: check-in and check-out are only available for today.
frontdesk.assign_room_first: Assign a room to every stay first
frontdesk.check_out_hint: Guests leaving before their planned date give up the remaining nights
frontdesk.room_not_ready_body: The guest can still take the room now if they accept it as it is, or wait for housekeeping.
frontdesk.early_departure_body_one: The guest was due to leave on {{date}}. {{count}} night will be released and removed from the bill.
frontdesk.early_departure_body_other: The guest was due to leave on {{date}}. {{count}} nights will be released and removed from the bill.
frontdesk.balance_due_body: The guest still owes {{amount}}. Take the payment before check-out.
frontdesk.credit_body: The guest has paid {{amount}} more than the bill.
frontdesk.keep_credit: Keep as credit and check out
frontdesk.move_room_body: The guest moves from {{date}}: nights before stay on the current room, the remaining nights keep their price.
frontdesk.no_free_room: No room is free for the rest of the stay

billing.page_description: Payments received (with totals per method and currency for the cash-up) and issued invoices.
billing.invoice_outdated: The folio changed after invoice {{number}} was issued. Void it and issue a new one if the guest needs an up-to-date invoice.
billing.void_charge_body: The charge stays visible on the folio, struck through, and is removed from the total.
billing.void_payment_body: Use this for a payment recorded by mistake. To give money back to the guest, record a refund instead.
billing.void_invoice_body: The invoice keeps its number and is marked void. You can then issue a new invoice.
billing.card_last4_hint: Never enter the full card number
billing.reference_hint: Terminal authorisation code, transfer reference… never a card number
billing.service_hint: Choose from the catalog, or leave empty to enter any item
billing.invoice_hint: The invoice is a fixed copy of the folio with the next invoice number. It cannot be edited, only voided.
billing.cancellation_fee_due: Cancellation fee under the booking's policy: {{amount}}. It will be added to the guest's folio.
billing.no_show_fee_due: No-show fee under the booking's policy: {{amount}}. It will be added to the guest's folio.
billing.no_invoices_hint: Invoices are issued from a reservation's folio.

housekeeping.description: Today's cleaning tasks: plan and assign them, follow progress room by room, inspect finished rooms.
housekeeping.summary: {{pending}} to do · {{in_progress}} in progress · {{done}} awaiting inspection
housekeeping.arrival_today_hint: A guest arrives in this room today: clean it first.
housekeeping.no_tasks_hint: Use “Prepare today's list” to create the day's cleaning tasks from the rooms' situation.
housekeeping.skip_body: Why is room {{room}} not being done? (e.g. “Do not disturb”, guest refused service)
housekeeping.reject_body: What must be redone in room {{room}}? The task goes back to the housekeeper and the room is marked dirty.

maintenance.description: Repairs and technical problems: report them, follow them up, and take rooms out of service while they are being fixed.
maintenance.title: Problem
maintenance.take_out_of_service: Take the room out of service
maintenance.take_out_hint: The room cannot be sold for these dates. Refused if a guest is in the room or a booking is assigned to it.
maintenance.back_in_service_done: The room can be sold again from tonight
maintenance.cancel_releases: The room goes back in service from tonight.
maintenance.release_room: Put the room back in service from tonight
maintenance.needs_cleaning: The room needs cleaning after the work (sends a task to housekeeping)

restaurant.description: Tables, orders, kitchen, payment (including charging the guest's room), breakfasts and sales.
restaurant.no_outlet: No restaurant or bar is set up
restaurant.no_outlet_hint: Create the hotel's restaurant, bar or room service, then its menu and tables.
restaurant.setup_outlet: Set up a restaurant or bar
restaurant.cancel_body: Why is this check cancelled? Items already sent to the kitchen need a supervisor.
restaurant.empty_check: Tap items on the menu to add them.
restaurant.void_item_body: Why is {{item}} voided? It is removed from the bill and counted in the void report.
restaurant.void_payment_body: The payment is cancelled and the check is open again. A room charge is also removed from the guest's folio.
restaurant.room_charge_hint: The whole check is added to the guest's folio and paid at check-out.
restaurant.sold_out_hint: Switch off an item when it runs out: it can no longer be ordered until you switch it back on.
restaurant.no_breakfast_hint: Guests whose rate includes breakfast (bed & breakfast, half board, full board, all inclusive) appear here the morning after each night.

setup.outlets_hint: Each place that sells food or drinks: restaurant, bar, café, room service. Taxes come from Configuration → Taxes (scope “Food & drinks” or “All sales”).
setup.service_charge_hint: Added to every check before taxes (0 for none)
setup.facility_hint: Optional link to the facility shown to guests
setup.taxes_hint: Prices are entered as on the menu; inclusive taxes stay inside them, exclusive taxes are added to the check.
setup.no_categories: Create a category first (e.g. Starters, Mains, Drinks).
setup.station_hint: Where the order is shown when sent
setup.tables_hint: Tables of the selected outlet. Add several at once: “T1” until 10 creates T1 to T10.

vehicles.description: Scooters, cars, bicycles and more: bookings, hand-over and return with odometer and fuel, deposits, contracts and payment (or charge to the guest's room).
vehicles.late_hint: This vehicle is back late: the extra time is charged at the vehicle's rates (the first 59 minutes are free).
vehicles.change_end_hint: The vehicle price is recalculated; refused if another rental needs the vehicle.
vehicles.cancel_body: Why is this rental cancelled? The vehicle becomes available again.
vehicles.room_charge_hint: The whole rental is added to the guest's folio and paid at check-out.
vehicles.void_payment_body: The payment is cancelled. A room charge is also removed from the guest's folio.
vehicles.licence_hint: Stored encrypted; only the last 4 digits are shown
vehicles.condition_placeholder: Scratches, dents, missing items… (also helmets, keys)
vehicles.deposit_given_back: Deposit given back to the renter
vehicles.waive_late_fee: Do not charge the late return
vehicles.fleet_hint: Every vehicle the hotel rents out, with its rates and documents. A vehicle whose insurance or registration has expired cannot be rented.
vehicles.no_fleet_hint: Add the scooters, cars or bicycles the hotel rents out.
